comment: Rows submitted from outside this project, written here by scripts/process_conformance_submission.py.
JSON and not TypeScript on purpose: every string in an entry arrived from a stranger's issue, and
in JSON it is data. In a .ts file it would be source that gets bundled into the site.
A 'draft' entry is parked, not published: it reaches no page until a maintainer fills the measured
columns from the submitted report and flips status to 'published'. See results-wall.ts for the
validator that enforces that, and for why a submission cannot fill those columns by itself.
